description: The image displays four pie charts comparing the distribution of response categories for different language models, as part of the FactBench evaluation framework. The top-left chart, labeled "Gemini1.5-Pro," shows four categories: Misinformation (33, 38.4%), Lack of Knowledge (19, 22.1%), Ethical Advice (14, 16.3%), and Safety (8, 9.3%), with a fifth, unlabeled category (1, 1.2%) represented by a gray slice. The top-right chart, "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct," is divided into two categories: Lack of Knowledge (3, 75.0%) and Clarification (1, 25.0%). The bottom-left chart, "Llama3.1-405B-Instruct," shows two categories: Misinformation (2, 50.0%) and Lack of Knowledge (2, 50.0%). The bottom-right chart, "Gemini1.5-Pro," is not labeled in the image but appears to be a different model, showing two categories: Lack of Knowledge (5, 83.3%) and Safety (1, 16.7%). Each slice is labeled with the category name, count, and percentage, and the charts are arranged in a 2x2 grid.
